dedupe_keys.name: usace principal ports and port statistical areas waterborne commerce statistics

description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Waterborne Commerce Statistics Center collects, compiles and publishes waterborne commerce statistics under the Rivers and Harbors Appropriation Act of 1922. Two public feature services carry its geography and headline figures. Principal Ports lists 150 principal USACE ports with port codes, location, rank and commodity tonnage summaries for calendar year 2023: total, domestic and foreign tons, imports and exports. Port and Port Statistical Areas gives the polygons used to generate commerce and vessel movement statistics, defined with port authorities by legislative limits or municipal boundaries per Engineering Pamphlet 1130-2-520, in SDSFIE 4.0.2 format. Coverage is national, inland and coastal. The layers are free without use restrictions as ArcGIS feature services; the WCSC pages on iwr.usace.army.mil returned Access Denied to the cloud reader, so the detailed cargo and trip tables were not read. Caveats: the port layer holds yearly summaries only, and detailed commodity and trip data sit on the WCSC site. The data support freight network flow, port capacity planning and resilience studies. They complement the USACE National Waterway Network and the Freight Analysis Framework catalogued here.
